technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with hull flip and new highs, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200) and Ichimoku cloud, creating mixed intermediate-term conviction.

fundamental.summary: CSGP shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 40 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: No current congressional signal; stale buy activity (9+ months old) from junior member; market in fear state presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirming sentiment data.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (418.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and FOMC event just passed create severely adverse macro conditions for real estate; earnings in 40 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, three white soldiers, and new 10-day highs show genuine short-term momentum reversal with strong ADX and supertrend confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis 418.4, flat yield curve, rising dollar, post-FOMC), price trapped below all key moving averages (50/200 SMA, 50 EMA, Ichimoku cloud), zero fundamental support, and earnings event risk in 40 days make this a high-risk fade into fear-driven technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Hull flip and three white soldiers show genuine short-term momentum, but this is a fear-driven technical bounce into a macro crisis environment with zero fundamental support.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (418.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and post-FOMC volatility will likely overwhelm short-term technicals; earnings in 40 days create binary event risk in real estate sector.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical shows momentum but all other agents (fundamental, sentiment, risk, debate) align on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already 22 positions in Real Estate sector; adding CSGP increases concentration risk during macro stress without fundamental justification.
